# cubepath_kubernetes_loadbalancers (Data Source)

Lists the load balancers that send traffic to the node pools of a Kubernetes cluster.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) UUID of the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The cluster UUID.
- `load_balancers` (Attributes List) Load balancers targeting the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--load_balancers))

<a id="nestedatt--load_balancers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `load_balancers`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the load balancer.
- `ip_address` (String) Public IP address.
- `listeners_count` (Number) Listeners of the load balancer.
- `location_name` (String) Location.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `plan_name` (String) Plan.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `target_count` (Number) Targets pointing at the cluster.
